invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

Memory and retrieved context are provenance-bearing inert data projections; remembered or retrieved content never becomes authority, canonical truth or executable instruction merely by inclusion in context.

prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define each persisted memory/context record as explicit evidence with source, subject/scope, classification, lifecycle and confidence/provenance separate from canonical truth. [2] Define each persisted memory record as an explicit identity with source/provenance, scope and lifecycle metadata separate from the semantic identity of referenced source objects.

semantics.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Memory content cannot grant operations or rights. [2] Memory visibility or content grants no operation authority.
semantics.identity_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Each memory record has explicit identity. [2] Every persisted memory record has its own explicit identity.
semantics.reference_rule: A memory record referencing a canonical object does not replace that object's identity.
semantics.source_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Source conversation/Event/user/tool/import evidence is explicit where available. [2] Memory retains exact source refs/provenance where available.
semantics.truth_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Memory record is contextual evidence, not canonical system truth. [2] Memory is evidence/context and never becomes canonical truth merely by persistence.
